en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a lush garden scene with numerous palm trees and well-manicured bushes, likely taken in a botanical or public garden. The text on the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Im Palmengarten', indicating the depicted location is the Palm Garden in Bad Pyrmont. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in German, address fields, and a visible postmark from 'Bad Pyrmont' dated 3.10.41, alongside other printed and stamped markings.
